newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star to acquire Energy Reclaim.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star to acquire Energy Reclaim.

text.p: Lone Star International Energy Inc said on Friday it is in a tentative agreement to buy the assets of Energy Reclaim Refrigeration Inc for $10 million of restricted stock.
The restricted Lone Star stock uses a valuation of $3.00 a share, the company said.
Energy Reclaim owns and has filed for certain patents in the alternative energy industry, Lone Star said.

Calvin Cline, the sole stockholder of Energy Reclaim Refrigeration, will enter into an employment/service contract to serve as an officer and director of Energy Reclaim, which will operate as a subsidiary of Lone Star, the company said.
